About Us

A fully incorporated Nigerian company with 17 years of proven operational experience.

Skaj & U Investment Nigeria Limited has built a strong reputation for sustainable waste disposal systems, recycling innovation, public-sector cleanliness management and value-addition manufacturing — while contributing to food security and employment through agriculture.

Explore Our Solutions See Our Impact

Established in 2007 and incorporated under the Corporate Affairs Commission, Abuja, Skaj & U operates across manufacturing (egg crates, plastic recycling and other recycled products), recycling and waste management, environmental sanitation services, agriculture and livestock farming, interior decoration from recycled cotton, and general contracting. We've successfully delivered waste management and recycling solutions for multinational corporations, local governments and commercial institutions, and remain actively engaged in long-term contracts with industry leaders.

Our Mission

To design and implement efficient, environmentally responsible, and commercially viable solutions in waste management, recycling, agriculture, and manufacturing through innovation, structured systems, and strategic partnerships.

Our Vision

To be a leading Nigerian company in environmental sustainability, recycling, and agro-industrial development, delivering scalable solutions that support government initiatives, private sector growth, and environmental protection.

Solutions

Eight integrated solutions, one purpose.

From recovery to manufacturing, every solution turns what's discarded into what's needed.

Explore All Solutions
Carton Recovery & Baling
Collecting and compressing cartons for re-entry into the paper supply chain.
PET Bottle Recycling
Sorting and processing plastic bottles at scale, one tonne every hour.
Waste Sack Recycling
Reclaiming used sacks and reworking them into usable raw material.
Waste Nylon Recycling
Diverting nylon waste from landfill back into manufacturing.
Egg Crate Manufacturing
Producing egg crates from recovered pulp, twelve bundles every hour.
Organic Manure
Converting organic by-products into manure that restores farmland.
Sustainable Interior Solutions
Recovered cotton reworked into pillows, cushions and teddy bears.
Integrated Farming
Closing the loop between recycled inputs and healthier, productive farms.
